changelog:
Version 1.0.2

- Added new script: scripts/nano_banana_mood.py
- Updated image generation instructions in SKILL.md:
  - Panel layout now requires inventing short, distinct TOP (1–2 words) and MIDDLE (3–6 words) lines for each story (not forming full sentences).
  - Enforced stricter icon variety; icon pairs must be distinct across panels and generic icons should be used sparingly.
summary: On-demand ORF news digest in German. Use when the user says 'orf', 'pull orf', or 'orf 10'. Focus on Austrian politics (Inland) and international politics (Ausland) + major headlines; exclude sports. Send each item as its own message (Title + Age + Link). Then generate a Nano Banana image in a cartoon ZiB studio with the anchor presenting the news, plus subtle Easter eggs based on the selected stories.
